description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training set is divided among different data sources, with 12 labeled slices in total. The largest slice is NQ (blue) at about 31.3%. Other sizable slices include FEVER (teal/cyan) at about 16.1%, SNLI (orange) at about 15.4%, VITAMINC (light teal) at about 13.0%, and MULTNLI (salmon/pink) at about 11.3%. Smaller slices are ANLI (orange) at about 4.6%, FACTCC (yellow) at about 2.6%, ENTFa (green) at about 1.8%, XSUMHUL (very light blue) at about 1.6%, SCITAIL (greenish) at about 1.2%, and two very small slices labeled PUBHEALTH (pale yellow) at about 0.5% and MULTIFC (light purple) at about 0.5%, plus SCIFACT (gray) at about 0.1%. Percentages are shown next to each label via leader lines around the pie, there is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
